title: Concurrent posting for General Ledger entries
summary: The posting process for General Ledger entries now supports concurrent processing, improving performance when posting multiple journal entries simultaneously across finance, purchasing, and sales modules.
key_points: Concurrent posting enabled for G/L Entry operations across multiple ledger types
Posting codeunits (Gen. Jnl.-Post Line, Gen. Jnl.-Post Batch) restructured to handle parallel execution
Register tables and detailed ledger entries updated to support concurrent inserts
Changes applied consistently across localization layers (APAC, BE, CH, DACH, ES, FI, FR)
Reports and utility codeunits adjusted to work with concurrent posting logic
